name: ocean-procession
title: Ocean Procession
description: A persistent GPU flotilla flocks, separates, and sails a wind-shaped many-octave sea through reflected sky, refracted light, caustics, foam, and wakes.
controls: Move pointer to steer the wind · Number keys 0-9 select Beaufort force
techniques: persistent GPU flocking · collision avoidance · wind-coupled differentiable waves · analytic buoyancy · ray-traced sailboats · Fresnel reflection and refraction
